identity.name: Clarity
identity.notes: The official 2026 site, exact-address ordering page, and live reservation link resolve to the same operating Vienna restaurant. The new Reston location is a separate location and is not merged into this record.

sources.excerpt: The current official Clarity site identifies the restaurant at 442 Maple Ave E, Vienna, VA 22180, publishes daily hours, and links dining, reservations, ordering, catering, and the current menu hub.
The official reservation page invites current bookings for lunch, dinner, the Chef's Table, Main Dining Room, and covered patio and links the restaurant's OpenTable profile.

Fresh browser inspection of the current menu hub found exactly five live document links: Dinner, Tasting, Dessert, Wine, and Craft Cocktails/Beer/BTG. The previously indexed Father's Day link is no longer present.
The PDF currently embedded by Clarity's Dinner Menu page contains 25 distinct named food products across First Course and Main Course, with descriptions but no comprehensive allergen matrix.

The PDF currently embedded as Tonight's Tasting Menu names four food products: Seared Giant Tiger Prawns, Lobster & Black Truffle Risotto, Mountain River Venison Backstrap, and Chocolate Hazelnut Cake. Unnamed chef and pastry gifts are not enumerable products.
The current dessert PDF contains eight desserts, two coffee preparations, and seven teas. Its rum, cognac, armagnac, port, and Sauternes sections are alcohol-only and excluded.

The current cocktails/beer PDF contains one explicitly named nonalcoholic product, Clausthaler Non Alcoholic IPA. All other listed wines, cocktails, beers, and cider are alcoholic and excluded. The printed '>0.5%' notation conflicts with its Non Alcoholic label and is preserved as a source typo, not silently corrected.

The Owner-powered live ordering surface identifies 442 Maple Ave E and exposes 23 distinct current food products after Popular repeats are consolidated. Six are additional to the current dinner PDF: French Onion Soup Kit, Wild Mushroom Bisque, Pear & Apple Salad, Tuna, Ribeye, and Burger.

Clarity's catering FAQ says the restaurant will make its best attempt to accommodate gluten-free, vegan, allergy, and other dietary restrictions and asks guests to call directly for specific requests.

Fresh targeted searches for the exact Vienna identity, current menus, allergens, ingredients, nutrition, official documents, and linked ordering reconfirmed the official surfaces and found no restaurant-issued comprehensive allergen matrix or conflicting Vienna identity.

matrixSearch.notes: All four required search classes were completed. Positive allergen evidence is limited to literal ingredients in restaurant-issued or restaurant-linked descriptions. Products without direct positive evidence remain unavailable; absence is never treated as an allergen-free claim.

restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.statement: Clarity says it will make its best attempt to accommodate dietary restrictions, including allergies, and directs guests to call for specific requests.
restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.notes: This is an accommodation statement, not a product-specific allergen guarantee or a cross-contact control statement.

findings.summary: Clarity is currently operating at 442 Maple Ave E in Vienna with live official hours, ordering, and reservations. The separately announced Reston location is not merged.

The exact in-scope union is 53 distinct food and explicitly nonalcoholic products: 25 dinner, four tasting, 17 dessert/coffee/tea, one nonalcoholic beer, and six additional live-ordering products not on the dinner PDF.

The frozen 20-row catalog is a narrow seasonal subset. Standalone Black Tiger Shrimp is no longer offered; current tiger-shrimp preparations are materially different. Full Portion is a Bolognese price/portion option label, and the duplicate Half Chicken take-out record collapses to the current Half Chicken product.

No comprehensive official allergen matrix, full ingredient table, or cross-contact policy was found after all four required searches. Direct positive allergens from literal menu ingredients are preserved; unsupported negatives are not inferred.

Clarity offers only a best-attempt accommodation statement and asks guests to call with specific restrictions. It does not establish absence, dedicated preparation, or cross-contact controls for any product.

The beverage PDF explicitly names Clausthaler as Non Alcoholic IPA but prints '>0.5%'. The product remains in scope by the restaurant's explicit nonalcoholic label, while the contradictory notation is preserved rather than silently corrected.

proposedChanges: Replace the frozen 20-row subset with the 53-product current union across the live Vienna dinner, tasting, dessert/coffee/tea, nonalcoholic-beer, and Owner ordering surfaces.
Remove stale standalone Black Tiger Shrimp and the Full Portion parser artifact; consolidate the duplicate Half Chicken take-out presentation.
Normalize current seasonal names while retaining live ordering-only French Onion Soup Kit, Wild Mushroom Bisque, Pear & Apple Salad, Tuna, Ribeye, and Burger.

Preserve only direct positive allergen evidence from literal restaurant descriptions and keep all unsupported allergen fields accurately unavailable; retain the generic accommodation statement separately.
